battle.name: 芒市河之戰
battle.brief: 至元十四年（1277），元朝雲南行省奉詔招撫緬國蒲甘王朝，並派兵沿茶馬古道南線南下，在德宏芒市河一線與緬軍及金齒、麓川諸部接戰。招撫與用兵同時進行，卻在河谷受阻，元軍未能渡河。配重投石車隨蒙古軍隊進入雲南，準備砸壞山寨的夯土牆與木柵，是此役中技術含量最高的裝備。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 交戰的兩方，一方是元朝在雲南的軍政體系，另一方是緬甸的蒲甘王朝與它在雲南西部的附庸網絡。至元十四年（1277）時，雲南仍由賽典赤家族主持：忽必烈於1253年遣兀良合率軍入滇，次年攻下大理，段興智出降，雲南自此入元朝版圖；賽典赤・沙姆斯丁受命治滇，在滇中設宣慰司、行省衙署與軍鎮，漢軍、唐兀、答剌罕等編制與本地爨姓土軍並行，又從西域帶來回回砲手與工匠，為後來西南方面的攻城作準備。雲南行省對西南邊地長期以土官與寨羈縻，芒市一線的土司與麓川、金齒一帶的傣族諸部，名義上歸附而實力自守。另一方面，緬國蒲甘王朝以大象與弓弩立國，王室以白象象兵為精銳核心，僧伽與地方土邦構成外圍，雲南西部的金齒、麓川諸部多與蒲甘有納貢、聯姻與軍事互助的關係。雙方在茶馬古道南線上既做茶、馬、鐵器的生意，也互相覬覦渡口與山寨。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Yuan military-administrative system in Yunnan on one hand, and the Burmese Pagan kingdom together with the network of its client polities in western Yunnan on the other. In 1277, the fourteenth year of the Zhiyuan era, Yunnan was still governed through the family of Sayyid Ajjal: Kublai Khan had sent Uriyangkhadai with an army into Yunnan in 1253, Dali fell in the following year, Duan Xingzhi surrendered, and from that moment Yunnan entered the Yuan empire; Sayyid Ajjal Shams al-Din was appointed to govern the province, where he established the xuanweisi, the offices of the provincial administration and the military garrisons, with Han, Tangut and Darughan formations marching alongside the local Duan-lineage native troops, and he also brought Muslim artillerymen and engineers out of the west, preparing the southern front for siege work. Along the far south-west the Yunnan administration held the local tusi and the stockaded villages on a leash of loose allegiance; the tusi of the Mangshi line and the Tai polities of Luchuan and Jinchi in western Yunnan nominally submitted while in fact keeping their own armed strength. On the other side stood the Pagan kingdom of Burma, a state that built its strength on war elephants and bows, with the white war elephants of the royal house as its elite core and Buddhist establishments and local lords forming the outer ring; the Tai states of Jinchi and Luchuan on the Yunnan border stood to Pagan through tribute, marriage alliance and military cooperation. Along the southern branch of the Tea Horse Road the two sides traded tea, horses and iron, and each eyed the fords and stockades of the other.
people: 推動這場衝突的人分屬兩個世代。忽必烈是一切決策的源頭：他正把元朝的注意力從北方草原轉向海上與南方，計劃以雲南為基地打通安南、占城一線，完成對高棉的包抄，因此必須在雲南與緬甸之間取得一個通道；至元十四年，他詔令雲南行省先遣使招撫蒲甘，兵備待用。雲南方面主持其事的是賽典赤的後人：賽典赤於至元十三年（1276）病逝雲南，其子忽孫、孫子朵兒只先後領銜雲南軍政，延續其安民懷遠、不使大軍深入的政策，這一取向與忽必烈急着南征的要求張力十足。緬方主事者是蒲甘王忽賓（Kyaswa，1254年至1287年在位），此時蒲甘正處於王位交替與兄弟爭端的動盪期，他把雲南的招撫視為吞併的前奏，拒絕稱臣。後來至元二十四年（1287）元軍大舉征緬，統軍的宗王忽都暉與雲南方面多名將領折在緬境，芒市河一役可以視為元朝在這條邊界上第一次付諸兵力而未見成果的試探。
peopleEn: The men who drove this clash belong to two different generations. Kublai Khan was the source of every decision: he was turning the attention of the Yuan state away from the northern steppe and towards the sea and the south, planning to use Yunnan as a base from which to open the line towards Annam and Champa and complete the encirclement of the Khmer, and he therefore needed a corridor between Yunnan and Burma; in the fourteenth year of Zhiyuan he ordered the Yunnan administration to send envoys to pacify Pagan first while the troops stood ready. On the Yunnan side the work was in the hands of Sayyid Ajjal's descendants: Sayyid Ajjal died in Yunnan in the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan (1276), and his son Husun and grandson Dorzhi in turn headed the military government of the province, carrying on his policy of pacifying the people, courting the distant tribes and not committing the great army to deep penetration, a course that stood in obvious tension with Kublai's impatience to push south. On the Burmese side the man in charge was the king of Pagan, Kyaswa, who ruled from 1254 to 1287; Pagan was then in a period of disputed succession and fraternal rivalry, and he read the Yunnan embassy as the opening move of an annexation, so he refused to acknowledge suzerainty. Ten years later, when the Yuan sent a great army against Burma in the twenty-fourth year of Zhiyuan (1287), the prince Quduq commanding it and several commanders of the Yunnan force were destroyed inside Burma; the battle of the Mangshi River can be read as the first time the Yuan had actually committed troops on that frontier without obtaining a result.
kits: 這張卡牌的兵器是配重投石車（Trebuchet），一件用長臂與尾端的配重把投射物甩出去的攻城機；它成形於西亞與中亞，12世紀已隨十字軍與土耳其人的戰爭進入歐洲與伊斯蘭世界，13世紀又隨蒙古西征東來。配重投石車在中國最早的實戰記載見於13世紀中葉的襄陽攻防，回回砲手以巨石與配重標槍攻城；此後元軍各路都配備西域砲手與匠人，雲南前線並不例外。芒市一線的據點是夯土牆、木柵與寨樓構成的山地聚落，牆矮而厚、木構多，正好給遠距離拋射以著力點：石彈可以砸塌牆段與柵門，命中寨內密集的守軍與器械，也可以先用它打散大象隊形。除了這件機器，兩軍的基本裝備仍有長矛、標槊、複合弓與弩、刀與短柄斧；元軍的甲胄多為中亞式的札甲與鎖子甲片，進攻靠騎兵與步兵混編，馬匹是蒙古馬、滇馬與雜色騾，糧秣靠馱馬隊自滇中一路運來的稻米與鹽磚。緬方以大象作衝鋒，象背立塔樓、象夫持刀矛，象兵披象甲並以長矛與象刀近戰；步兵多持貢榜弓一類的竹木複合弓，箭密而射速高。河谷地帶還備有竹木與竹篾編織的渡具，糧食用稻米、椰子與魚乾，木材與石料就地取材。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the counterweight trebuchet, a siege engine that throws its missile with a long arm and a counterweight slung at the tail; it was developed in West Asia and Central Asia, had already reached Europe and the Islamic world in the twelfth century as the Crusades and the Turkish wars carried it eastward, and came to China in the thirteenth century with the Mongol campaigns in the west. The earliest record of the counterweight trebuchet in Chinese warfare belongs to the siege of Xiangyang in the middle of the thirteenth century, where Muslim artillerymen used heavy stones and counterweight-launched javelins against the walls; from then on every Yuan army detachment was supplied with artillerymen and craftsmen from the west, and the Yunnan front was no exception. The strongpoints of the Mangshi line were hill settlements built of rammed-earth walls, timber palisades and watch towers: low but thick walls and much timber, which gave the long-range thrower exactly the surfaces it needed. A stone could smash down a stretch of wall or a gate of the palisade, fall on the defenders and the machines crowded inside the stockade, or break up the formation of elephants before they closed. Beyond that machine, both armies still carried the ordinary equipment of the age: long spears, javelins, composite bows and crossbows, sabres and short-handled axes. The Yuan panoply was largely Central Asian, lamellar plate and mail; their attack was fought by combined cavalry and infantry, with Mongol horses, Yunnan horses and mongrel mules carrying the burden, and with grain, rice and salt bricks moving up the line on mule-back from the interior of Yunnan. The Burmese answered with elephants: a tower on the animal's back, an elephant-driver with knife and spear, war elephants wearing their own armour and fighting at close quarters with lances and the elephant-goad; the foot soldiers carried bows of the gongbang type, bamboo laminated with hardwood, throwing a thick and rapid shower of arrows. The river valleys also carried bamboo and rattan craft for crossing, and the larder was rice, coconut and dried fish, with timber and stone taken from the spot.
tactics: 元軍自滇中南下，走的是茶馬古道的南線：出大理、經楚雄、越滇西山地、抵永昌騰越一線，再沿河谷直指芒市。隊伍以步騎混編的縱隊前進，前鋒是偵騎與小股步兵，中軍帶著象、馬、器械與糧隊，行軍縱列拉得很長，補給全靠人背、馬馱、象負。接近芒市河時，前哨先在兩岸高處佔點，弓手居高壓制，控制能涉渡的淺灘與竹橋；主力則在下游寬處展開，準備強渡。投石車在這個局面下有兩種用途：一是把石彈越過河面砸向對岸土牆與柵門，二是壓住渡口一帶，把守軍從城頭與寨樓趕下來，掩護步兵涉水。緬軍的應法是利用河谷兩側的陡坡與密林，弓弩手居高臨下輪射，牽制元軍的渡河點，大象伏在林緣，待元軍部分渡過再突然衝出，以象的體量撞散渡口的盾陣；同時派小股騎兵繞襲元軍的糧隊與柴水汲取點，切斷遠征賴以為生的糧道。雙方在芒市河一線反覆拉鋸，誰也沒能把對方逐出河谷。
tacticsEn: The Yuan army came south from the interior of Yunnan along the southern branch of the Tea Horse Road: out of Dali, through Chuxiong, over the mountains of western Yunnan, to the line of Yongchang and Tengyue, and then straight down the river valley toward Mangshi. The column marched as a mixed force of foot and horse, with scouts and small bodies of infantry in front, the centre carrying the elephants, horses, siege machines and baggage, and the marching line stretched out very long, since all supply went on men's backs, on mule-back and on elephants. As they neared the Mangshi River the outposts took the high ground on both banks first, archers shooting down from above and controlling the shallows and bamboo bridges that could be forded; the main body deployed in the wider stretch downstream, ready to force a crossing. In this situation the trebuchet had two uses: to throw stones across the water onto the opposite earthen wall and palisade gate, and to bear down on the crossing itself, driving the defenders off the ramparts and the watch towers so that the infantry could wade forward under cover. The Burmese answer was to use the steep slopes and the close forest on both flanks of the valley: bowmen shot from above in relays to hold the Yuan crossing points, elephants waited concealed at the edge of the trees, and when part of the Yuan force had crossed they charged out suddenly, using the sheer mass of the animals to break the shield wall at the ford; at the same time small bodies of horse rode round to harass the baggage train and the places where firewood and water were drawn, cutting the supply line on which a distant expedition lived. The two sides pulled at each other along the Mangshi River without either driving the other from the valley.
data: 可查證的數字非常有限，這場戰鬥的規模只能靠前後史事推量。時間上，元代史書把它繫在至元十四年（1277），雲南的行政轉折也發生在同一時期：賽典赤於至元十三年（1276）病逝，忽必烈在至元十四年下詔招撫緬國，至元二十年（1283）再遣使一次，真正的大舉用兵要到至元二十四年（1287），而那一役元軍全軍覆沒，宗王忽都暉戰死。地理上，芒市在瑞麗東南約二十公里處，至雲南西界與緬境姐告一線約三十餘公里，再順江而下到八莫約二百里；芒市河屬瑞麗江水系，經瑞麗、畹町出境後匯入伊洛瓦底江。參戰兵力的數字，正史沒有留下，後世說法從數千到數萬都有而無一可核，本站不採用任何單一數目；傷亡與俘獲數同樣無記載。唯一能確定的規模指標是：一支必須自滇中遠征、隨軍攜帶攻城器械與糧秣的分隊，其最低補給量以數千匹健畜與大批稻米鹽磚為底線，這也是元廷每次南征都要先議糧道的原因。時令方面，本站採用四月，正是西南雨季開始、弓弦受潮、象力未復的時節，江谷炎熱潮濕、山路泥濘，行軍與渡河的效率都要打折。
dataEn: Very few numbers survive, and the scale of this fight can only be inferred from the events before and after it. As to time, the Yuan histories place it in the fourteenth year of Zhiyuan (1277), and the administrative turning point of Yunnan fell in the same stretch of years: Sayyid Ajjal died in the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan (1276), Kublai ordered the pacification of Burma in the fourteenth year, another embassy followed in the twentieth year (1283), and the real campaign came only in the twenty-fourth year (1287), when the Yuan army was destroyed and the prince Quduq was killed. As to geography, Mangshi lies some twenty kilometres south-east of Ruili and about thirty kilometres from the Yunnan border and the Burmese post of Jiegao, with a further two hundred li downstream by the river to Bhamo; the Mangshi River belongs to the Shweli system and, passing Ruili and Wanding, leaves Chinese territory and joins the Irrawaddy. No figure for the numbers engaged survives in the official record; later estimates run from a few thousand to tens of thousands and none of them can be verified, and this site therefore adopts no single number; the counts of casualties and of prisoners taken are equally unrecorded. The one firm indicator of scale is this: a detachment that had to march from the interior of Yunnan and carry siege engines and baggage with it needed at minimum thousands of sound draught animals and a great quantity of rice and salt bricks, which is precisely why the Yuan court always argued about the supply line before every southern expedition. As to season, this site takes April, the month in which the south-western rainy season opens, when bowstrings dampen and the elephants are not yet in condition; the river valleys are hot and sodden and the mountain tracks turn to mud, and the efficiency of marching and fording falls accordingly.
cause: 打起來的直接原因是忽必烈要一條通往南方的大路。元朝在南方的戰略是三路並行：草原線、山東海路與雲南陸路，最後都要匯到安南、占城去；雲南往南的山地與河流被蒲甘卡在中間，元廷必須讓雲南行省同緬國談判，或者繞過緬國另尋他路。至元十四年遣使招撫，是先禮後兵：使者要蒲甘王接受稱臣與通使，蒲甘卻不願把朝貢關係坐實，更不願讓元朝的軍隊沿著自己的國境線紮營。邊境上的摩擦早已存在：茶馬古道南線是滇中茶、鹽、鐵器換緬甸與雲南西部良馬的商路，沿線有土司、寨主與僧侶權力，緬甸王室的督責與元朝行省的地方治理互相牴觸，商人被攔、寨子被攻、馬匹被扣的事不斷發生。再加上蒲甘王位繼承的內部爭端，緬方寧可先在邊境試探元軍的虛實，也要把元朝的使團和先鋒擋在國境線之外。於是一次外交使命變成了河谷裡的交火。
causeEn: The direct reason for the fighting was that Kublai Khan needed a great road to the south. The Yuan strategy in the south ran on three parallel lines — the steppe, the sea route from Shandong, and the overland line through Yunnan — all of which were meant to converge on Annam and Champa; the mountains and rivers of the country south of Yunnan were held by Pagan in the middle, so the Yuan court had either to make the Burmese negotiate or to look for another way around them. The embassy of the fourteenth year of Zhiyuan was the first half of the formula, courtesy before force: the envoys were to obtain the Burmese king's recognition of suzerainty and the establishment of intercourse, but Pagan was unwilling to make that relationship of service permanent, and even less willing to let Yuan troops camp along its frontier. Friction on the border had existed for a long time. The southern branch of the Tea Horse Road was the road along which the tea, salt and iron of central Yunnan were exchanged for the fine horses of Burma and western Yunnan; along it lay the authority of tusi, stockade lords and monasteries, and the scrutiny of the Burmese court collided with the local administration of the Yuan provincial government: merchants were stopped, stockades were attacked, horses were seized. On top of this came the internal dispute over the Burmese succession; the Burmese would rather test the strength of a Yuan force on the frontier beforehand, and keep the Yuan envoys and vanguard on their own side of the boundary. Thus a diplomatic mission turned into a firefight in the river valley.
impact: 這場戰鬥的結果之一，是元朝在西南的計劃被推遲。六年間雲南行省沒有再對緬國用兵，直到至元二十年（1283）再遣使、至元二十四年（1287）才傾國來攻；而1287年的結局比1277年更壞，宗王忽都暉與大軍在緬境覆沒，雲南方面折損多名將領，朝廷不得不改弦更張，改為厚結德宏土司、修築寨堡、封閉商路上的衝突。對蒲甘而言，芒市河的僵持換來了喘息：它保住了王室的獨立與南方通道，也讓元廷看到，雲南的山地、密林與象兵不是北方騎兵可以橫掃的東西，此後元朝在雲南的用兵重點轉向防守與屯墾，而非深入緬甸。對技術而言，這一役是配重投石車這類西亞與中亞攻城器械傳入雲南西南前沿的早期痕跡之一；元軍靠西域砲手與匠人的技術維持對西南山地城寨的壓力，也說明十三世紀的雲南戰爭，已經不只是刀矛與弓弩的較量，而是工程、糧秣與交通的較量。
impactEn: One of the results of this battle was that the Yuan plan for the south-west was set back. For six years the Yunnan administration did not use troops against Burma again: another embassy went out in the twentieth year of Zhiyuan (1283), and the full-scale campaign came only in the twenty-fourth year (1287) — and the outcome then was worse than in 1277, with the prince Quduq and the whole army destroyed inside Burma and several commanders of the Yunnan force lost, so that the court had to change its tune, relying instead on the tusi of Dehong, on building stockades and on closing the incidents that broke out along the trade road. For Pagan the stalemate on the Mangshi River bought a breathing space: it preserved the independence of the royal house and the southern corridor, and it taught the Yuan court that the mountains, the close forest and the elephants of Yunnan were not things northern horsemen could sweep away, so that from then on the Yuan military effort in Yunnan turned towards defence and settlement rather than a deep march into Burma. In terms of technology, this campaign is one of the early traces of the counterweight trebuchet and its family of West Asian and Central Asian siege engines reaching the far south-western front of Yunnan; the Yuan maintained pressure on the mountain stockades of the south-west with artillerymen and craftsmen from the west, which shows that the warfare of thirteenth-century Yunnan was no longer a matter of blades, spears and bows alone, but of engineering, supply and lines of communication.
result: 打完之後，芒市河兩岸的局勢回到了戰前：元軍沒有渡過這條河，也沒有拿下河谷裡的芒市寨；招撫的使團空手而回，雲南行省把這次出兵記作無功而止。關於勝負，正史著墨極少，後世說法分歧：一說元軍前鋒在渡口受挫，鎩羽而歸；一說元軍以砲石破了寨柵、逼退緬軍，只是未能追入緬境。站得住腳的部分是：無論哪一說，這場戰鬥都沒有為元朝打開緬甸通道，招撫沒有成功，元軍在南下的第一次試探就停在德宏的山谷裡。此後元朝改變策略，1283年再遣使仍被拒，1287年才下大軍，結果全軍覆沒於緬甸境內，宗王忽都暉戰死；其後緬軍反攻雲南邊地，元廷一面加築堡寨、一面與蒲甘往來，最終在1290年代議和，雲南邊界的緊張局面維持了相當長的時間。這場戰鬥的具體經過、雙方兵力與傷亡數字都已無從考證，今日可確定的，只是1277年春夏之交，雲南行省在芒市河試探蒲甘的邊防，而那條河始終沒有被渡過去。
resultEn: When the fighting was over, the situation on both banks of the Mangshi River had returned to what it had been before: the Yuan army had not crossed the river and had not taken the stockade of Mangshi in the valley; the embassy had gone home empty-handed, and the Yunnan administration recorded the expedition as a failure and stopped there. As for who won, the official histories say very little and later accounts disagree: one version has the Yuan vanguard checked at the ford and driven back with loss; another has the Yuan breaking the palisade with stones from the engines and forcing the Burmese to withdraw, but without pursuing them into Burma. The part that can be relied on is this: on either version the fight opened no corridor to Burma for the Yuan, the pacification failed, and the first probe of the south by the Yuan army stopped in the valleys of Dehong. The Yuan then changed its method; the second embassy of 1283 was refused as well, the great army of 1287 was annihilated inside Burma and the prince Quduq was killed there; afterwards the Burmese counter-attacked the Yunnan border, and the court at once built more forts and opened correspondence with Pagan, until the two sides made their peace in the 1290s and the tension along the Yunnan frontier lasted for a very long time. The course of the battle, the numbers engaged and the losses cannot now be recovered; what can be established is only this: in the spring and early summer of 1277 the Yunnan administration tested the Burmese frontier at the Mangshi River, and that river was never crossed.
